name: Fence (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): The ninja has such vast experience with stolen items and trade goods used in bribes, she can instinctively and immediately determine the value of objects she sees. The ninja may make an Appraise skill check (to determine an item’s value, or determine the most valuable item of a hoard) as a swift action. If a ninja chooses to make such an Appraise check as a standard action, she may roll the check twice and take the better of the two results.

Ultimate Options: Power of the Ninja © 2011, Rogue Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
